translation.name: Habo nalolene bi gahenge lo winigo ogo

content: Ana Tobidila miniha genda yu berenego ogo

Ai Tobaiasa dai nabiaore dege Tobidi ibugua Tobaiasa ibu Lagese pialu dai bulene horo ogodaguaore piya lowa daga lalu hene. Ani lalu howa ibunaga miniha ibu igini biago pialu dai bulene horo piai hayabe toba howa mitangi tangi bini. Ani biyagola Tobidihanda ibu onehondo lamialu lalu,
Ainde mbirale mbirame iya igini emene mo luma hayagola ibu abale dai nabiaruabe tobaneda. Ainde Gabaele ibuni homayagola agali mendeme Tobaiasahondo muni namiyagola ka bada, lene.
Ani layagola Tobidi ibu tiniha mini burugu lama irigi hene.
Ani biyagola Anahanda lalu, I̱ igini homayada. I̱ mandaore bido, lene. Ani lowa ibugua Tobaiasa dara howa kiabu dugu bialu lalu,
I̱ iginiore-o í̠ i̱naga gubalini haabo heneore ndobe. Irane aginaga í̠ yupe halu pu laruyabe, lene.

Ani layagola Tobidihanda ibuhondo lamialu lalu, Tobaiasa ibu bayale karulape holebirago dugu nabi waha, lene. Libu abale dai bulenego mbirale mbirame mo luma haragola kabada laro. Agali libu piribigo ibu ina hameigini mbiraoreni agali bayaleni hongohela piribigo í̠ manda bide. Í̠ mogolalu mini burugu nale waha. I̱na manda bialu koria Tobaiasa áyu ogoni dai bialu harigani ibira lo manda bido, lene.

Ani layagola wali biagome ladai bialu lalu, Wahalu waha. I̱ dugu bialu biruliya í̠ ani heyu harene. Í̠na i̱ mohondo nahabe. I̱ igini homaore biyada, lene. Ani bialu howa horo bibahendengi Ana ibu egerebagiore gao laga biragola puwa hariga Tobaiasa piyagoria pu haga biaga. Ani hondo haga dege bialu alendo halu ni anda pugu bini. Ibu tomo nane dege haabo heane alendo dai bigi bialu ibu igininaga dugu bima daibu palialu egerebagi gao laragola heyalu pugu bigi biaga. Ibu u emeneorebi napale haabo haga hene.
Tobaiasa Labaelela Egebadana tano wahalu penego ogo

Ai Laguelehanda ibu wane Sarahondo buleore lowa gi dolalu dabu bininaga tomo timbuniore dawale lalu bi lenego tomo ogoni nalu hemine sarere kira piya. Ani piyagola ainde Tobaiasa ibugua Laguele berearia puwa ibuhondo hale halu lalu, Ainde i̱ni dalu dai buliya í̠na karulapego pu loleberebe. Ainde i̱ aba ai̱yalame mini burugu timbuniore lalu libugua i̱ dengui lone nahondoleda lowa genda timbuni yu biraruago. Ainde Laguele-o í̠ aba ai̱yala karia dai bia la. Ai i̱na ibalu abale í̠hondo ibunaga de kirabali ndibulo wahalu ibunibi nde agali waheore beda lalu í̠ langirugoni, lene. Ani layagola Laguelehanda ladai bialu lalu. Igini-o i̱na agali maru bi yalu í̠ aba karia puwa í̠ karulape ka lalu lama pudaba loliya ai í̠ i̱nila holene karulape, lene.
Ani layagola Tobaiasahanda hondo howa lalu, Ani ndo i̱ anidagua nabuleorego ainde i̱ aba karia dai bia larene, lene.

Ani layagola Laguele ibugua emene hondo ha nabi Sara Tobaiasa ibu mini. Ani bialu ibunaga mbirale bibahende hanuni talebu ki howa mendehayagi Tobaiasa mialu bini. Wali agali garabaya biabe ale biaga hearubi nogo bulumagabi sibi hearubi dongi hearubi kamele hearubi yári tara tara wiarubi muni wiarubi hanuni talebu ki howa mendeha Tobaiasa mini.

Laguelehanda Tobaiasa nu̱nu̱ lowa ibuhondo bi bayale lamialu lalu, I̱ igini-o ainde pobe. Dahuliya andaganaga Ngode Datagaliwabe ibunime Sara libu baya hangu mamage howa handaya ho holebirago libu bayale pialu anda pilibu. Ainde libunaga waneigini harago i̱ni de ngui hondolene hamelo kogoni, lene.

Ani lowa Laguele ibugua Sarahondo lamialu lalu, Áyu í̠ agalinila pamia. Puwa ibu aba ai̱ya andaga kagoha biraabo habe. Í̠ ai̱ya iya í̠ aba ai̱yala hama ibinigo áyu kabagonidagua dege igiri ibu aba ai̱yala í̠ aba ai̱yala ho birabe. Libugua í̠hondo bi bayale dege langialu lene hale halu biraabo howa homalu waholene hameledo, lalu Laguelehanda ibu wane Sarahondo lamini. Ibugua libuhondo, Pilibu, lalu bi lai howa, Ai libu pudaba, lene. Ai Edena ibugua Tobaiasahondo lalu, Tobaiasa í̠ore i̱ igini bayale. Anduane Homogohanda í̠ baya hangu í̠ni andaga haru dai bulebira. Ani bialu i̱bi nde í̠ waneigini harago de hondoliya Anduane Homogohanda baya hangu handaya ho helo laro. Ai Anduane Homogo ibugua i̱naga bi larogo hale holebira. I̱ waneore í̠ baya hangu handaya ho habelo ngero. Aiore nde halu mbira hanguorebi ibunaga miniha mo ko holene ale mbira nabibe. Áyu libu harigani bayale pilibu. Áyu Sara ibu í̠ one bedagoni. I̱ í̠ ai̱ya biraro. Ina haga haga bu kamaha bayale howa turu ho haabo hami̱ya Ngode Datagaliwabehondo bi lolebero, lene. Ani lai howa Edenahanda ogolabo nu̱nu̱ lalu, Ai pudaba, lene.
